assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring via CPT 93226 (48-hour Holter monitoring study) is indicated.
The appeal is submitted in response to denial code PR-204.
The claim was rendered on day 36.
The appeal falls within the ninety-day appeal window established by the payer notice.
